text: Testing a Google Form usually means filling it in yourself. Again. And again. And again.
Crowdfill does it for you, with people who actually feel real.
Open your form, click the icon, and it reads every question. Scales, grids, branching, even your validation rules.
Then decide who's answering. A happy crowd, an unhappy one, or one that's split right down the middle.
Everyone gets a mood, so each person's answers actually agree with each other.
Want a question to lean a certain way? Pick the answer, drag the strength, and watch the numbers follow.
Or describe the people you want, and let Claude write them. Each one answers the whole form in character.
Look over every response before a single one is sent.
Then set the pace, press send, and watch your results come in, leaning exactly the way you planned.
Crowdfill. Free, private, and open source. Made by dyrt dot I O.
